PHASE 25 CONFIGURATION CONTRACT FIXTURES

[accepted]
src/config/config.act
  open values;
src/config/values.act
  open const DEFAULT_THRESHOLD: u8 = 30u8;
src/main.act
  import config;
  verb main() -> Int { return DEFAULT_THRESHOLD as Int; }

[rejected: configuration-import]
src/config/config.act
  import aie;
  open values;

[rejected: runtime-declaration]
src/config/values.act
  verb runtime_state() -> Int { return 1; }

[rejected: direct-child-bypass]
src/main.act
  import config::values;

[rejected: private-constant]
src/config/values.act
  const PRIVATE_LIMIT: u8 = 1u8;
src/main.act
  import config;
  verb main() -> Int { return PRIVATE_LIMIT as Int; }

[rejected: dependency-cycle]
src/config/config.act
  import aie;
src/aie/aie.act
  import config;
